senses.gloss:
mf. (-रिः-री)
A kettle drum.
E.
भी to fear, to cause fear, Uṇādi aff. कीन्; otherwise, रन् aff., and ङीप् added.

mfn. (-ण्डः-ण्डा-ण्डं)
Formidable, fearful.
f. (-ण्डा)
One of the Yakṣiṇīs, or female attendants on DURGĀ.
m. (-ण्डः)
A particular deity; a form of ŚIVA, according to the Tantras.
n. (-ण्डं)
Conception, impregnation.
E.
भी to fear, deriv. irr.; it is sometimes read भेरण्ड.
